title: CRM Settings
description: Manage your sales pipelines and custom fields.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Configure your sales pipeline stages for tracking customer progress
pipelines.info: Pipelines help you track customer journey from lead to conversion. Drag customers between stages in the Pipeline Board to update their status.

empty.description: Create your first pipeline to start tracking customer progress

customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Define custom data fields to capture additional customer information
customFields.info: Custom fields allow you to store additional information about your customers. These fields will appear in the customer detail view and can be filtered in reports.

empty.title: No custom fields yet
empty.description: Create your first custom field to capture additional customer data

dialog.createDescription: Create a new custom field to capture additional customer information.
dialog.editDescription: Update the field settings. Note that key and type cannot be changed.
dialog.fieldKeyHelp: Used to reference this field in the API

customFields.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This will remove all data for this field from all customers. This action cannot be undone.
